requirements.text: Students should be able to borrow items online with real-time availability.
Students should be able to return items online and receive a confirmation.
Students should be able to renew items online as long as no hold is on them.
Automated reminders should be sent to students before due dates.
The library management system must allow students to view their current loans, due dates, and outstanding fines in one place.
Students should be able to book study rooms online with a calendar view and filtering options.
Students should receive confirmation emails after booking study rooms.
Students should be able to cancel or modify their bookings online.
Automated reminders for upcoming study room bookings should be sent to students.
The system must automatically calculate and apply fines for overdue items.
Immediate email notifications should be sent to students when fines are applied.
Students should be able to view their outstanding fines alongside their current loans.
Accounts with outstanding fines above a certain threshold should have borrowing and booking restrictions.
Librarians should be able to easily add new items to the catalogue.
Librarians should be able to update existing entries in the catalogue.
Librarians should be able to retire items that are no longer in circulation.
The system must allow tracking of the status of items (checked out, on hold, available).
The system should generate reports on loan volumes, popular items, room utilization, and fine revenue.
Reports must be customizable and can be run on a regular schedule.
A user-friendly dashboard for librarians should provide key metrics and insights at a glance.
The system must be mobile-friendly for both students and staff.
The system must comply with GDPR for customer data storage.
